description.text: Gets the current status of the auto rename feature. Earlier, the status of this feature was controlled only by a single time evaluation of the CDS_COPY_AUTO_RENAME shell environment variable. This environment variable defines the initial status setting for this feature. Now, the ccpSetAutoRename function allows you to change the status after the startup initialization.

items.desc: The auto rename feature is enabled.
The auto rename feature is disabled.

returns.text:
t
The auto rename feature is enabled.
nil
The auto rename feature is disabled.

example.text:
ccpGetAutoRename()
=> t
The auto rename feature is enabled.
